detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Your head is a bad place to keep a to-do list. Every open loop you're holding competes with the task in front of you.

Before work today: set a 90-second timer and write down everything on your mind: tasks, worries, errands. No sorting.

When it rings, circle one item to do first. Sort the rest later. It's on paper now.

#productivity
